notes: Cash-basis school district; one governmental funds statement (pp4-5, total governmental funds column on p5; left half on p4). No business-type funds (School Nutrition is a special revenue fund in the governmental funds statement). Beginning/ending cash = total governmental funds beginning/ending fund balance (cash plus funds held by County Treasurer). Local receipts line (11,812,750) split by category with split_from, using each fund column's Local receipts (p4) and its fund schedule lines (pp6, 11-14), which add exactly to the printed line (Bond Fund interest 33,568 sits inside Local receipts); non-revenue receipts 15,163 split into 8,766 sale of assets + 6,397 insurance using General Fund schedule p7. Functions for private grants/state categorical/federal programs and lease payments guessed (review). Detail: General Fund schedule (pp6-8) lists spending by function/program only, so detail_category not itemized; the General Fund schedule (receipts 18,377,676; disbursements 16,762,964) plus Depreciation fund (32,552; 240,716; transfer in 300,000) combine into the statement's General Fund column (receipts 18,410,228; disbursements 16,703,680): 16,762,964+240,716-300,000 = 16,703,680, so a 300,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund is inside General Fund disbursement lines (which lines is not shown; statement vs schedule differences are instruction -22,500 and operations/maintenance -36,784); detail lines kept as printed plus a -300,000 contra expenditure line and a -300,000 other financing line in the General Fund detail (detail_totals expenditure includes other financing). Top-level transfers stay null: the transfer is between funds within the same statement column and nets to zero. Activities and Student Fee funds together equal the Other Governmental Funds column. Statement of Net Position used for balance_sheet (governmental activities only column, cash basis, no liabilities). Fund balance total 14,092,919 (p3) agrees. Read pages 1-16 of 16.
